projects.project_name: MRT-3 Rehabilitation Project
projects.project_description:
Rehabilitation of the service and safety level of the existing 16.9 km MRT-3 to its expected performance as originally designed. It involves the overhaul of 72 Light Rail Vehicles (LRVs), replacement and rehabilitation of the tracks, upgrading of the electrical and mechanical (E&M) system, and the repair of depot equipment, among others.
